data.title: Delivery note and invoice for dining table and chairs
data.summary: Möbelmanufaktur Musterwendel GmbH delivered the ordered dining table "Chiemgau" (oak, 180×90 cm) and six chairs to Veronika Musterchiem on 18 November 2026. The total price of €3,034.00 has already been paid, and a 14-day statutory right of withdrawal runs from the delivery date.
data.explanation: This is the delivery note and invoice for the dining table and chairs you ordered on 26 October 2026, delivered and fully paid for on 18 November 2026. As a consumer you have a 14-day right of withdrawal (Widerruf) starting from the day you received the goods, so you may still decide to send the furniture back without giving a reason — the app shows the deadline. To withdraw, send a clear statement (e.g. letter or email) to the seller before the deadline; it's enough that you send it in time, it doesn't need to arrive by then. If you withdraw, the company collects the furniture at its own cost and refunds the price. No action is needed if you want to keep the items.

key_facts.label: Order date (Bestellung vom)
key_facts.quote: Ihre Bestellung in unserem Onlineshop vom 26.10.2026 ist damit vollständig erfüllt; dieses Blatt erhalten Sie zusammen mit der Ware.

key_facts.label: Delivery date
key_facts.quote:
unser Auslieferungsteam hat Ihnen heute, am 18.11.2026, den Esstisch „Chiemgau“ in Eiche
(180 × 90 cm) und sechs Stühle geliefert und aufgebaut.

key_facts.label: Right of withdrawal period (Widerrufsfrist)
key_facts.quote: Sie können Ihre Bestellung binnen vierzehn Tagen widerrufen, ohne Gründe zu nennen.

items.title: Decide whether to withdraw from the purchase (Widerruf)
items.action: If you want to return the table and chairs, send a clear withdrawal statement (letter or email) to the seller before the deadline shown.
items.consequence: If you don't withdraw in time, the purchase becomes final and the furniture cannot be returned on this basis.
items.quote:
Sie können Ihre Bestellung binnen vierzehn Tagen widerrufen, ohne Gründe zu nennen. Die Frist läuft ab dem
Tag, an dem Sie die Ware erhalten haben.
